name: Samuel English
role: Medora dealer in fruits, fish and game
bio: Sam English came to Medora in April 1884 to go into business and was soon dealing in fruits, fish and game; in November 1884 the paper announced the birth of his daughter. By early April 1885 he and his wife had moved to Brainerd, where he was interested in land along a new railroad.

moments.label: Selling fish in his new fruit, fish and game business
